snippet.title: Exclusive Look: Jimmy Lightning Returns to Peggle 2
snippet.description: Take an exclusive, behind-the-scenes look at how skater-punk and wub-wub enthusiast Jimmy Lightning was brought to life in Peggle 2. Jimmy Lightning is available now, only on Xbox One.
